request.spec:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A rollover now soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, and all 4 acceptance tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is all in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/RolloverYear.java`:
- **When:** after the `ROLLOVER` line is written, the rollover re-reads the old year's periods in start-date order.
- **Which periods:** any that is neither closed nor soft-closed. Periods already closed are left alone, so in the first test 2026-11 is skipped.
- **How:** each is closed through the same `PeriodCloser` the soft-close button uses. So every one gets the same fixed figures and pool cuts and writes its own `PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED ... total=...` line.
- I also updated the class comment to describe this.

No database or front-end change was needed. The soft-closed state already shows after the sheet is re-loaded.

Undoing a rollover does not re-open the periods it soft-closed. It still only removes the periods and opening balances it created. The request didn't cover undo, so I left it as it was.
